evidence.note: Dark green/black camp chair is compactly folded in the corner near the entrance alcove.
Chair fabric fills the foreground as the chair is being deployed.
Chair is visibly unfolded with its seat, arms, and legs extended.
Chair remains unfolded immediately before the closing interval.
Chair is again compactly folded and leaning in its original corner.

events.object_description: Dark green/black folding camp chair in the corner near the room entrance

evidence.note: A second dark green/black camp chair is folded beside the bright window.
The chair passes very close to the camera while being unfolded.
The chair is fully open beside the standing desk.
Chair remains open shortly before it is put away.
Chair is folded compactly in the window-side corner again.

events.object_description: Dark green/black folding camp chair in the window-side corner beside the standing desk

evidence.note: Blue high-back camp chair is folded in the corner between the bed and window.
Blue chair fabric fills the foreground during deployment.
Blue chair is visibly unfolded with its frame and seat extended.
Chair remains fully unfolded near the window.
Close, blurred view of the chair during the apparent folding action.
Blue chair is compactly folded in the corner.

events.object_description: Blue high-back folding camp chair in the corner between the bed and window

notes: The t=1–160 camera survey was treated as setup. Three spatially distinct folded chairs are visible during the survey, so their similar opening-and-closing episodes are counted separately. No other localized object-state changes are supported.
scene_description: A bright bedroom-office containing a bed, standing desk, and three folding camp chairs staged in separate corners. After an initial room survey, each chair is unfolded, observed in its open state, and folded again.
